verdict.rationale: incident.io ships multiple built-in AI capabilities you can delegate to: Investigations (an agentic system that gathers evidence, forms and pressure-tests hypotheses to find root cause), Postmortem AI (drafts and redrafts postmortem sections), and Suggestions/Scribe (auto-drafting updates, summaries, follow-ups, and call transcription) — all native, not third-party bolt-ons. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of Investigations' accuracy and reliability, and clearer scope of what tasks can be fully delegated vs. only suggested.
